title: Cleaning of the Fwd Cabin Divider Bays and the Void Above the Panel Line
abstract: Deep cleaning of the forward cabin divider bays and of the void above the divider panel line, done at the cabin refresh visit with the divider panels and the adjacent ceiling panels removed.

sections.purpose: This task gives the deep cleaning of the forward cabin divider bays and of the void above the divider panel line, which is not reachable during a normal turnaround clean.
sections.job_setup_note: This task is done at a cabin refresh visit with the divider panels and the adjacent ceiling panels out. Use only the approved cabin cleaning agents; solvents attack the decorative finish and the damage is not repairable in situ. Protect the seats below the work area. Where an absorbent lining is fitted in the void, do not wet it: a damp lining will hold moisture against the structure for weeks.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the divider trim D2520138833226 and the adjacent passenger compartment trim D2520000645001. 2. Remove the ceiling panels above the divider line in zones 221, 291 and 222. 3. Protect the seats and the floor below the work area. 4. Remove the curtain rail 280DL and keep the floating barrel nuts AES161226K4 with it. 5. Vacuum the void with a soft brush head, working from the panel line upward. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A SOLVENT CLEANING AGENT ON THE DECORATIVE FINISH. THE FINISH WILL CRAZE AND THE PANEL CANNOT BE REPAIRED IN POSITION. 6. Clean the visible structure with the approved aqueous agent and a damp cloth. 7. Where an absorbent lining is fitted, vacuum it only and do not wet it. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE VOID IS DRY BEFORE THE PANELS GO BACK. TRAPPED MOISTURE CAUSES CORROSION AND MICROBIAL GROWTH. 8. Clean the partition 39DL9 upper edge and the divider latch 36DL. 9. Do a general visual inspection of the void for spillage tracks and report any that reach the structure. 10. Install the curtain rail, the ceiling panels and the divider trim.
sections.close_out: Record the cleaning and any spillage track finding on the cabin work card. Confirm that the divider panels and the curtain rail operate correctly. Remove the seat protection and do a final visual check of the decorative finish under cabin lighting. Report any panel that has been marked during the work so that it can be scheduled for replacement.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Where an acoustic lining is fitted in the divider void, step 7 applies and the lining must not be wetted.

safety_precautions: Use only approved cabin cleaning agents.
Protect the seats and the floor below the work area.
Make sure that the void is dry before the panels go back.

tooling.description: Cabin vacuum unit with soft brush head
